svg.aria-label: ARGtest pipeline overview: inferred ARGs are screened for low recombination, poor accessibility and aberrant mutation load; flagged regions are trimmed from all samples and outlier individuals are pruned per window; outputs are cleaned ARGs, validation plots and a summary report.
